'''Hydron''' was a substance that could be stored in a [[Class-L cargo container|Class-L]] [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo]] [[Xizor cargo container|container]]. Class-L containers holding hydron were stored in the [[Azzameen family]]'s [[Azzameen cargo fields|cargo fields]].
